wargear.name: Warp-brand
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. The unit has been marked by one of the Powers, a sigil burned into the flesh that will not heal. All models in the unit gain +1 Attack.

wargear.name: Ruin-shard crown
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A fragment of the Ruinstorm worn as a diadem, bleeding unreality into the air. The bearer's unit gains Fear (1).

option.text: Up to four Lesser Daemons may exchange their claws for
One Brute may bear a totem
The Harbinger may exchange its blade for
Up to three Beasts may exchange their maw and talon for
Up to three Pink Horrors may exchange their warpfire for
The unit may bear the brand of a Power

rites.name: The Gnashing Tide
rites.flavor: The Ruinstorm does not march. It rises, and it keeps rising.
rites.text: Lesser Daemons cost 20 points less, Daemon Swarms cost 15 points less, and Harriers and Riders may fill Troops slots. A tide has no champions: no Lord of War units and no War Engines. At least one Lesser Daemons unit is required.

require.note: The tide needs its Lesser Daemons.

rites.name: The Pale Banner of Fate
rites.flavor: The future is a river, and a river can be made to run uphill if you ask it in the right voice.
rites.text: Flamers and Screamers of Tzeench may fill Troops slots, and every Tzeench unit gains +1 Willpower. The army must be faithful to the Changer: only Tzeench daemons and Heresy-born war machines, no Ruinstorm units and no Ka'bandha, Cor'bax or Samus. At least one Lord of Change, Ascendant Lord or Herald is required.

modifiers.text: The Pale Banner of Fate: +1 WP.

rites.name: The Red Tide of Ka'bandha
rites.flavor: Skulls for the throne. All of them. All at once.
rites.text: Ruinstorm Daemon Brutes and Blood Slaughterers may fill Troops slots, and Brutes gain +1 Attack. The Blood God allows no sorcery: no Psykers and no Tzeench units. Ka'bandha must be fielded.

rites.name: Rot Unbidden
rites.flavor: It does not hurry. It has never needed to.
rites.text: Every Ruinstorm daemon (Malefic model) gains Feel No Pain (6+) and the Behemoth and Greater Daemon Beast may fill Elites slots. The Plague drags its feet: every Malefic model loses 1 Movement, and the army brings no Recon or Fast Attack units. Cor'bax Utterblight must be fielded.

modifiers.text: Rot Unbidden: Feel No Pain (6+), -1 M.

rites.name: Rapture's Invitation
rites.flavor: They do not want to hurt you. They want you to ask them to.
rites.text: Harriers and Riders gain Fast (1) and +1 Initiative. Excess is a poor friend of discipline: no Heavy Assault or War Engine units, and the Behemoth, Brutes and Decimators are all barred. Samus must be fielded.
